newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Centennial reviews Allied Qld bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Centennial reviews Allied Qld bid.

text.p: Centennial Coal Co Ltd managing director Bob Cameron said on Monday the company would make an announcement about its 60 cent per share takeover bid for Allied Queensland Coalfields Ltd by the end of the week.

The bid was topped last week by a 70 cent per share bid by Marsford Investments, a subsidiary of Hong Kong's Consolidated Electric Power Asia Ltd. "We are reviewing our position in light of the Marsford bid and anticipate making an announcement by the end of the week," Cameron told Reuters. The Marsford bid values Allied Queensland at A$19.33 million.
Local brokers, anticipating a bidding war for the Surat Basin steaming coal miner, have pushed the Allied Queensland share price higher in recent days.
Allied Queensland shares were steady at the year's high of 74 cents at 3.55 p.m. (0555 GMT), but with an asking price of 76 cents.
Centennial paid 70 cents per share for its 10 percent stake in Allied Queensland in May this year.
The future of the coal miner rests with major shareholder Clyde Petroleum Plc which wants to offload its 43.4 percent stake.
